fusions.name: Lead Runner
fusions.desc: Looses a hound down a long lead. It deals 28 damage to the first enemy it reaches and leaves it [Marked] for 12 seconds. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Brought to Bay
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A weapon strike at the end of the lead that deals 22 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fetched to Heel
fusions.desc: Hauls up to 3 enemies within 6 tiles onto you on taut leashes and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Off the Leash
fusions.desc: A bonded hound on a leash fights beside you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
